The Primitive Campground provides you the safety and security of the military base while you enjoy an adventure in the great outdoors. Authorized patrons and Aurora CAC Pass Holders of all ages can enjoy bowling as bumpers are available for younger players. You’ll also find food and drinks at Chinook Winds Grill, to fuel another frame or two if you’re up for bowling, or power your meeting or party if you’re with a group.
